svg.title: Course Close: Retrospective, Handover and Your Path Forward
svg.text: Course Close: Retrospective, Handover & Your Path Forward
You built and operated a real distributed system as a team. Now close it like a pro: look back, hand it over, show it, keep growing.
What would we do from day one?
Bus factor = 1: only one person knows it
+ README · clean CHANGELOG · all kept current
A stranger can run, operate & extend it
Proof you can build & run distributed
systems — not just pass an exam
What you leave with — a pro distributed-systems toolkit
Design it → connect it → ship & run it → as a team
The head chef quits. Can the kitchen still cook

g.text: Why we cook it this way

svg.text: A new cook runs it on day one → bus factor > 1

g.text: Repo with no README or diagram
the field moves: keep the mindset, add tools

svg.text: THE MINDSET TRANSFERS TO ANY STACK → Design for failure · Make quality mechanical · Decide with evidence
